title: Geizhals Product & Offers Scraper
description: Get a Geizhals product record with manufacturer, current merchant offers, price summaries, categories, ratings, and review links. Batch product IDs to compare catalog entries.

product_ids.title: Product IDs
product_ids.description: Geizhals product IDs from product links or search results.

product_id.title: Product ID
product_id.description: Known Geizhals product id from product URLs such as ...-a2194110.html or a search gzhid.

loc.title: Market
loc.description: Market code: de, at, eu, pl, or uk. Defaults to de.

lang.title: Language
lang.description: Response language: de or en. Defaults to de.

offers.title: Offers
offers.description: Maximum number of merchant offers to include (1-100). Defaults to 20.

merchant_details.title: Merchant Details
merchant_details.description: Include merchant/shop details on offers. Defaults to true.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: Include test reviews and review details. Defaults to true.

videos.title: Videos
videos.description: Include product videos. Defaults to true.
